newsitem.title: USA: ALPINE SKIING-AUSTRIANS SHINE IN WOMEN'S WORLD CUP TRAINING.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-AUSTRIANS SHINE IN WOMEN'S WORLD CUP TRAINING.

text.p: Austrian racers took the measure of the women's downhill course in training for the World Cup Finals on Monday.
After Katharina Gutensohn of Germany posted the fastest time in the first trial heat of the day, the Austrians took over in the second.
Renate Goetschl led a 1-2-3 sweep with a time of 1:44.07. Stefanie Schuster was second in 1:44.65 and Alexandra Meissnitzer third in 1:44.72.
Goetschl's time was more than two seconds faster than Gutensohn's 1:46.31 in the first training run in which Schuster was third and Meissnitzer fourth. Goetschl finished eighth on her first try.
Italy's Isolde Kostner was the other constant in the two training runs. The World Cup super G champion finished second on the first run, fourth on the second.

Although Pernilla Wiberg of Sweden already clinched the women's overall title, three racers have a chance for the season downhill title. Warwara Zelenskaja of Russia has 423 points going into the last race, two more than Heidi Zurbriggen of Switzerland. Goetschl, with 403, also could win it.
Men downhillers are scheduled to take two training runs Tuesday. The downhill race for both men and women will be Wednesday.
